name: bitfield-synth
features: A typed math expression in x, y and t renders as a live animated pixel field, with errors shown for bad expressions.
Preset buttons load expressions like tunnel, xor, plasma and moire.
Audio from a loaded track or the microphone drives bass, mid, treble and beat values into the field.
Image layer loads a picture and blends it with diff, screen, multiply, overlay and dodge modes.
Palette buttons and effects like flash, blackout, invert, hue spin, scanlines and glitch apply live.
Pause stops animation and the menu opens and closes.
